folderBadges.checkFailedTitle: Converted files whose check after conversion found problems

delete.title: Delete from the server?
delete.summaryFolder: {what} will be deleted for good: {files}, {size}, including everything inside the folder.
delete.summaryFolders: {what} will be deleted for good: {files}, {size}, including everything inside {folders}.
delete.warning: This cannot be undone. If a download client (e.g. Deluge) is still seeding these files, it will report them as missing.
delete.jobsRemoved_one: The job is removed from the queue too (the conversion stays in Stats).
delete.jobsRemoved_other: The {count} jobs are removed from the queue too (the conversions stay in Stats).

move.title: Move on the server?
move.note: Nothing is overwritten. The files are moved in the background: a bar at the top of Sources shows how far it is, and you can cancel it. Between different disks or shares the files are copied and then removed, which can take a while for big files.
move.noteOutputs: Nothing is overwritten. The files are moved in the background: a bar at the top of the queue shows how far it is, and you can cancel it. Each job then shows its file in the new folder.

progress.title: Moving {done} of {total}
progress.cancelHint: Stop moving: the file being copied stays where it was, and what was moved already stays moved
progress.cancelMessage: The file being copied stays where it was, and the files still waiting are not moved. What was moved already stays in its new folder.
